alerts.reason: Cirrus reported 8% year-over-year net sales growth in the December quarter (A). Higher selling prices supported audio sales as smartphone units fell (B). Higher prices and more content per smartphone also lifted mixed-signal sales despite lower smartphone battery and power product sales (D). I expect those offsets to keep March-quarter growth above -5%, then weaken enough for June-quarter net sales to fall at least 5% year over year.
